up: For the assay identified by ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4689845, retrieve all activity measurements that have an exact relation (standard_relation = '='). For each such measurement, return the canonical SMILES of the compound, the molecule ChEMBL ID, the standard type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units. Only include rows where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null.
sql:
SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4689845'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
